response.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS b FROM Order_Items), o AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.order_id, o.avg_qty AS order_avg_quantity, o.avg_qty - base.b AS diff FROM o CROSS JOIN base WHERE base.b IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (o.avg_qty - base.b) IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
